attributes.heading: ex Chapter 33
attributes.subdivision: Essential oils and resinoids; perfumery, cosmetic or toilet preparations

attributes.rule: Manufacture from materials of any heading, except that of the product. However, materials of the same heading as the product may be used, provided that their total value does not exceed **20%** of the ex-works price of the product.
rule_class: CTH TOLERANCE MAY BE USED RESTRICTION MAXNOM

attributes.rule: Manufacture in which the value of all the materials used does not exceed **40%** of the ex-works price of the product.
